title: Aircraft Reliability
description: Per-aircraft (tail number) reliability from BTS on-time data: carrier-caused cancellations and delays, utilisation and out-of-service gaps.

list.name: catalog
list.label: Catalog
list.description: The Unity Catalog catalog holding the faa schema. scripts/grafana-provision.sh sets it from databricks.catalog.

list.name: airline
list.label: Airline
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT Reporting_Airline FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT Reporting_Airline FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime ORDER BY 1

list.name: min_flights
list.label: Min flights flown
list.description: Only aircraft that completed at least this many flights in the time range are ranked. Counting completed rather than scheduled flights keeps out placeholder tails, such as Frontier's N399FR, that airlines put on flights they cancel.

list.name: tail
list.label: Aircraft
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tail FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND tail RLIKE '^N[1-9][0-9A-Z]{0,4}$' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: tail numbers for the selected airlines

panels.title: Aircraft
panels.description: Distinct tail numbers that flew in range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT tail) FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND tail != ''

panels.title: Flights / aircraft-day
panels.description: Average flights per aircraft on the days it flew (utilisation).

targets.rawSql: SELECT try_divide(sum(flights), count(*)) FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND tail != ''

panels.title: Carrier cxl
panels.description: Cancellations the airline was responsible for (BTS code A: maintenance, crew, aircraft cleaning, baggage, fuelling...). Weather, air-traffic and security cancellations are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(cxl_carrier) FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND tail != ''

SELECT try_divide(1000 * sum(cxl_carrier), sum(flights)) FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND tail != ''

panels.title: Carrier delay / flight
panels.description: Minutes of delay attributed to the carrier (incl. maintenance), averaged over all completed flights.

targets.rawSql: SELECT try_divide(sum(carrier_delay), sum(completed)) FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND tail != ''

panels.title: Cxl with no tail
panels.description: Cancelled flights with no aircraft assigned. They are left out of every per-aircraft figure.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(cxl_carrier + cxl_other)
FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND tail = ''

panels.title: Airlines
panels.description: Per operating airline (regional carriers such as OO SkyWest, MQ Envoy and YX Republic fly for the majors). Flts/day = flights per aircraft per day flown; Cxl/1k = carrier cancellations per 1,000 flights; Delay min/flt = carrier delay minutes per completed flight; Delayed 15+ % = flights with 15+ min carrier delay.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Reporting_Airline AS Airline,
       count(DISTINCT tail) AS Aircraft,
       round(try_divide(sum(flights), count(*)), 1) AS `Flts/day`,
       round(try_divide(1000 * sum(cxl_carrier), sum(flights)), 2) AS `Cxl/1k`,
       round(try_divide(sum(carrier_delay), sum(completed)), 1) AS `Delay min/flt`,
       round(try_divide(100 * sum(delayed15), sum(completed)), 1) AS `Delayed 15+ %`
FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND tail != ''
GROUP BY Reporting_Airline ORDER BY `Cxl/1k`

panels.title: Aircraft by carrier-cancellation rate
panels.description: How many aircraft fall into each band of carrier cancellations per 1,000 flights (aircraft that flew at least the minimum number of flights).

panels.title: Reliability by aircraft model
panels.description: Carrier cancellations and delay by FAA make/model (10+ aircraft and 5,000+ flights, so widebodies that fly few domestic legs are left out). Model names are the FAA's exact type designations, so variants (737-8H4, 737-890...) appear separately.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(a.make_model, '(not in registry)') AS Model,
       count(*) AS Aircraft,
       sum(t.flights) AS Flights,
       round(avg(a.year_mfr), 0) AS `Avg built`,
       round(try_divide(1000 * sum(t.cxl), sum(t.flights)), 2) AS `Cxl/1k`,
       round(try_divide(sum(t.delay), sum(t.done)), 1) AS `Delay min/flt`
FROM (
    SELECT tail, sum(flights) AS flights, sum(cxl_carrier) AS cxl,
           sum(carrier_delay) AS delay, sum(completed) AS done
    FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND tail != ''
    GROUP BY tail
) AS t
LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info AS a ON a.tail = t.tail
GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 10 AND sum(t.flights) >= 5000
ORDER BY `Cxl/1k` DESC

panels.title: Reliability by aircraft age
panels.description: Aircraft age in years at the time of each flight (from the FAA registry's year of manufacture).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN age < 5 THEN '0-4' WHEN age < 10 THEN '5-9' WHEN age < 15 THEN '10-14'
            WHEN age < 20 THEN '15-19' WHEN age < 25 THEN '20-24' ELSE '25+' END AS bucket,
       round(try_divide(1000 * sum(cxl), sum(flights)), 2) AS `Carrier cxl / 1k flights`,
       round(try_divide(sum(delay), sum(done)), 1) AS `Carrier delay min / flight`,
       count(DISTINCT tail) AS aircraft
FROM (
    SELECT t.*, t.year - a.year_mfr AS age
    FROM (
        SELECT tail, year(FlightDate) AS year, sum(cxl_carrier) AS cxl, sum(flights) AS flights,
               sum(carrier_delay) AS delay, sum(completed) AS done
        FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND tail != ''
        GROUP BY tail, year(FlightDate)
    ) AS t
    INNER JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info AS a ON a.tail = t.tail
    WHERE a.year_mfr IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(age)

panels.title: Carrier cancellations by day
panels.description: Carrier-caused (code A) cancellations per day, including flights with no tail number. Weather and air-traffic cancellations are left out: they are not the fleet's fault and their storm spikes are 100x larger (see the Flight Delays dashboard).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, cxl AS `Carrier cancellations`,
       avg(cxl) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `7-day average`
FROM (
    SELECT CAST(FlightDate AS TIMESTAMP) AS time, sum(cxl_carrier) AS cxl
    FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote})
    GROUP BY 1
)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top 10 least reliable aircraft
panels.description: The ten aircraft with the most carrier cancellations per 1,000 flights, among those that flew at least the minimum number of flights; ties go to the one with more carrier delay per flight. The table below has the details. Click a bar to inspect that aircraft.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(tail, ' (', airline, ')') AS Aircraft, tail AS Tail,
       `Carrier cxl / 1k flights`, delay,
       -- as text, so they appear in the tooltip without being drawn as bars
       CAST(flights AS STRING) AS Flights, CAST(delay AS STRING) AS `Carrier delay min/flt`
FROM (
    SELECT tail, any_value(Reporting_Airline) AS airline, sum(flights) AS flights,
           round(try_divide(1000 * sum(cxl_carrier), sum(flights)), 1) AS `Carrier cxl / 1k flights`,
           round(try_divide(sum(carrier_delay), sum(completed)), 1) AS delay
    FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND tail != ''
    GROUP BY tail HAVING sum(completed) >= ${min_flights}
    ORDER BY `Carrier cxl / 1k flights` DESC, delay DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
ORDER BY `Carrier cxl / 1k flights` DESC, delay DESC

panels.title: Least reliable aircraft
panels.description: Aircraft that flew at least the minimum number of flights, worst carrier-cancellation rate first. Cxl = carrier cancellations; Cxl/1k = per 1,000 flights; Delay min/flt = carrier delay minutes per completed flight; Longest gap = longest run of days without a flight (often heavy maintenance or storage). Click a tail to inspect it below.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.Tail, t.Airline, a.make_model AS Model, a.year_mfr AS Built,
       t.* EXCEPT (Tail, Airline, days, `Last flown`), array_max(transform(days, (d, i) -> if(i = 0, 0, datediff(d, days[i - 1])))) - 1 AS `Longest gap`, t.`Last flown`
FROM (
    SELECT tail AS Tail, any_value(Reporting_Airline) AS Airline,
           sum(flights) AS Flights,
           sum(cxl_carrier) AS Cxl,
           round(try_divide(1000 * sum(cxl_carrier), sum(flights)), 1) AS `Cxl/1k`,
           round(try_divide(sum(carrier_delay), sum(completed)), 1) AS `Delay min/flt`,
           sum(diverted) AS Diverted,
           count(DISTINCT FlightDate) AS `Days flown`,
           array_sort(collect_set(FlightDate)) AS days,
           CAST(max(FlightDate) AS STRING) AS `Last flown`
    FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND Reporting_Airline IN (${airline:singlequote}) AND tail != ''
    GROUP BY tail HAVING sum(completed) >= ${min_flights}
    ORDER BY `Cxl/1k` DESC, `Delay min/flt` DESC
    LIMIT 100
) AS t
LEFT JOIN ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info AS a ON a.tail = t.Tail
ORDER BY `Cxl/1k` DESC, `Delay min/flt` DESC

panels.title: Registration
panels.description: From the FAA aircraft registry. Owner is often a lessor rather than the operating airline.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT make_model AS Model, year_mfr AS Built, seats AS Seats,
       if(registrant = '', '(not published)', registrant) AS Owner,
       if(registered = 1, 'Registered', concat('Deregistered ', CAST(cancel_date AS STRING))) AS Status
FROM ${catalog}.faa.aircraft_info WHERE tail = '${tail}'
SELECT sum(flights) FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND tail = '${tail}'
SELECT sum(cxl_carrier) FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND tail = '${tail}'

panels.title: Carrier cxl / 1k
panels.description: Compare with the fleet figure at the top.

targets.rawSql: SELECT try_divide(1000 * sum(cxl_carrier), sum(flights)) FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND tail = '${tail}'
SELECT try_divide(sum(carrier_delay), sum(completed)) FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND tail = '${tail}'
SELECT count(DISTINCT FlightDate) FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND tail = '${tail}'

panels.title: Longest gap
panels.description: Longest run of days without a flight.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT array_max(transform(days, (d, i) -> if(i = 0, 0, datediff(d, days[i - 1])))) - 1
FROM (SELECT array_sort(collect_set(FlightDate)) AS days FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND tail = '${tail}')

panels.title: Daily activity
panels.description: Flights per day. Gaps are days the aircraft did not fly.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(FlightDate AS TIMESTAMP) AS time,
       sum(completed) AS Flown,
       sum(cxl_carrier) AS `Carrier cancellations`,
       sum(cxl_other) AS `Other cancellations`
FROM ${catalog}.faa.tail_day WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND tail = '${tail}'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Disrupted flights
panels.description: Cancellations, diversions and flights with 15+ minutes of carrier delay, newest first. Cancellation codes: A carrier, B weather, C air traffic system, D security.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(FlightDate AS STRING) AS Date, Reporting_Airline AS Airline, Flight_Number_Reporting_Airline AS Flight,
       concat(Origin, ' → ', Dest) AS Route,
       lpad(CAST(CRSDepTime AS STRING), 4, '0') AS `Sched dep`,
       CASE WHEN Cancelled = 1 THEN concat('Cancelled (', CancellationCode, ')')
            WHEN Diverted = 1 THEN 'Diverted' ELSE 'Delayed' END AS Outcome,
       DepDelay AS `Dep delay`, CarrierDelay AS `Carrier delay`, LateAircraftDelay AS `Late aircraft delay`
FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND tail = '${tail}'
  AND (Cancelled = 1 OR Diverted = 1 OR CarrierDelay >= 15)
ORDER BY FlightDate DESC, CRSDepTime DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Flight history
panels.description: Every flight this aircraft was scheduled for in the time range, newest first, up to 5,000. Times are local to the airport (HHMM); delays are in minutes. Cancellation codes: A carrier, B weather, C air traffic system, D security.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(FlightDate AS STRING) AS Date, Reporting_Airline AS Airline, Flight_Number_Reporting_Airline AS Flight,
       concat(Origin, ' → ', Dest) AS Route,
       lpad(CAST(CRSDepTime AS STRING), 4, '0') AS `Sched dep`, lpad(CAST(DepTime AS STRING), 4, '0') AS Dep,
       DepDelay AS `Dep delay`,
       lpad(CAST(CRSArrTime AS STRING), 4, '0') AS `Sched arr`, lpad(CAST(ArrTime AS STRING), 4, '0') AS Arr,
       ArrDelay AS `Arr delay`,
       CASE WHEN Cancelled = 1 THEN concat('Cancelled (', CancellationCode, ')')
            WHEN Diverted = 1 THEN 'Diverted' WHEN ArrDelay >= 15 THEN 'Late' ELSE 'On time' END AS Outcome,
       Distance AS Miles
FROM ${catalog}.faa.ontime WHERE FlightDate BETWEEN CAST($__timeFrom AS DATE) AND CAST($__timeTo AS DATE) AND tail = '${tail}'
ORDER BY FlightDate DESC, CRSDepTime DESC
LIMIT 5000
